title.en: Checking a password with a hash

hints.tr: `stored = users.get(form.username)`; `stored is None` ya da `not hmac.compare_digest(stored, hash_password(form.password, SALT))` ise 401.
hints.en: `stored = users.get(form.username)`; 401 if `stored is None` or `not hmac.compare_digest(stored, hash_password(form.password, SALT))`.
